name: Trata
pitch: Trata is a road-safety startup. Its solution automatically detects a vehicle crash, estimates how severe it is, and then, without anyone having to do anything, calls the nearest ambulance and nearby cab drivers, alerts the family with a live location, and shares the hospital details. It uses sensors fitted in the vehicle (for example near the airbag and tyres) that send the signal to the person's phone app. The team is still talking to potential customers: is it useful, how would it work, which vehicles and which people would pay, and what should it cost (idea: a one-time sensor/installation fee when a car is bought, plus a small yearly subscription).

features.name: Automatic crash detection
features.description: Sensors detect that a crash has happened without the person doing anything.

features.name: Severity estimate
features.description: Tells how serious the accident is.

features.name: Automatic ambulance call
features.description: Contacts the nearest ambulance on its own.

features.name: Nearby cab drivers alerted
features.description: Calls nearby cab drivers to reach the spot and take the person to hospital.

features.name: Family alert and live location
features.description: Alerts the family directly and keeps sharing the live location.

features.name: Hospital details
features.description: Tells the family which hospital the person was taken to.

features.name: Vehicle sensors
features.description: Sensors fitted at several points of the car or bike (airbag, tyres) that send data to the phone.

features.name: Mobile app and website
features.description: App for the user and a website to track the ambulance.

features.name: Pricing model
features.description: One-time installation or sensor fee at purchase plus a yearly subscription.
